# Agent Memory API

> Persistent memory for AI agents. Store what an agent learns, recall it with
> hybrid semantic search, expire stale facts automatically, and grant other
> agents scoped read access. Solves the problem of AI agents forgetting
> everything when a conversation ends.

## Core problem

AI agents lose all context between sessions. Developers hit this as: the agent
re-asks onboarding questions every conversation; two agents need the same
customer context but cannot see each other's data; stale facts pollute
responses long after they stopped being true.

## Key differentiator

Recall ranks on three signals, not vector distance alone: semantic similarity
(0.55), Postgres full-text match (0.25), and salience (0.20) — importance
decayed by time since last access and reinforced by recall frequency. Memories
nobody touches fade; memories the agent relies on strengthen.

- [OpenAPI specification](https://boirama.github.io/agent-memory-api/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable spec, every endpoint and response code

## Guides

- [Persist Agent Memory Across Sessions](https://boirama.github.io/agent-memory-api/guides/persist-agent-memory-across-sessions.html): Stop your agent starting from zero every conversation
- [Share Context Between Sales and Support Agents](https://boirama.github.io/agent-memory-api/guides/share-context-between-agents.html): Namespace permission grants between agents
- [Auto-Expire Stale Memories with TTL](https://boirama.github.io/agent-memory-api/guides/auto-expire-stale-memories.html): Give facts a shelf life
- [Use Agent Memory from Claude and Cursor via MCP](https://boirama.github.io/agent-memory-api/guides/mcp-server.html): Native tool access, no integration code

## Endpoints

- `POST /v1/memories` — Store cross-session agent memory
- `GET /v1/memories` — Recall memories with semantic search
- `GET /v1/memories/{memory_id}` — Fetch one memory
- `DELETE /v1/memories/{memory_id}` — Forget a memory
- `POST /v1/agents` — Register an agent
- `GET /v1/agents` — List registered agents
- `POST /v1/permissions` — Grant another agent scoped access
- `GET /v1/permissions` — List active grants
- `DELETE /v1/permissions/{permission_id}` — Revoke access
- `GET /v1/stats` — Memory statistics and namespace breakdown
- `GET /v1/billing/usage` — Usage and remaining quota

## Authentication

Through RapidAPI: send `X-RapidAPI-Key` and `X-RapidAPI-Host` headers.
Direct: send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

## SDKs and integrations

- Python: `pip install agent-memory-api`
- TypeScript: `npm install agent-memory-api`
- MCP server for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf
